== Hero Usage ==
* Heroes maintain this enchantment both in and out of combat.

== Notes ==
* Due to its short cast time and low energy cost, Aura of Restoration makes a good [[cover]] enchantment.
* The healing from this enchantment considers only the base cost of the spells, without any [[Energy#Cost modifiers|modifiers]], such as [[Glyph of Lesser Energy]] or [[Quickening Zephyr]].
